children: RNS Number : 0424W  Premier African Minerals Limited  23 September 2026
Premier African Minerals Limited ("Premier" or the "Company") announces the results of the Company's General Meeting ("GM") held on 23 September 2026.
The four special resolutions were voted on by way of a poll, and the results are set out below. The proposed special resolutions were duly passed at the GM.
Disapplication of pre-emptive provisions for Creditor Settlement
Disapplication of pre-emptive provisions for Canmax conversion rights
The "For" votes include those giving the Chairman discretion.
Votes "For" and "Against" are expressed as a percentage of votes received.
The full text of the special resolutions was included in the notice of the General Meeting of the Company as announced on 3 September 2026.
A copy of this announcement is available at the Company's website, www.premierafricanminerals.com.

Premier African Minerals Limited (AIM: PREM) is a multi-commodity mining and natural resource development company focused on Southern Africa with its RHA Tungsten and Zulu Lithium projects in Zimbabwe.

The Company has a diverse portfolio of projects, which include tungsten, rare earth elements, lithium and tantalum in Zimbabwe and lithium and gold in Mozambique, encompassing brownfield projects with near-term production potential to grass-roots exploration.
